description: What tools/actions.py may bind an action to on this platform. Read only by Python tooling at build time; the engine never sees this file. Derived from engine/src/platform/psp/Input.cpp's TranslatePadButtons, which promotes the two shoulder-trigger bits onto L1/R1 and masks L2/R2 out entirely (the PSP has one shoulder row, no clickable-stick L3/R3, and only a left analog nub — the right stick is hard-zeroed every poll). PlatformCapability::AnalogTriggers is false; the trigger query instead mirrors the digital L1/R1 state, so there are no independent trigger sources.
